_doc: SPEC-104 Wyckoff phase classifier (capabilities/phase.py). Any key here overrides the documented default in DEFAULT_CFG. vol_lookback: trailing bars for the volume/range baseline. sc_vol_mult/sc_range_mult: climax thresholds (volume/range >= this x the trailing average). ar_window/ar_min_bounce_pct: AR search window + min bounce off the climax extreme. st_window/st_vol_ratio_max/st_retest_tolerance_pct: ST search window, max volume vs the climax, retest proximity tolerance. spring_window/spring_reclaim_bars: spring/UTAD search window + reclaim window. impulse_min_pct/impulse_max_bars: what counts as a clean breakout/breakdown impulse. grind_dwell_bars/grind_max_close_range_pct: the slow-grind/one-fish-two-eats trap flag.
